attribution: Researched, evidence-led merchant list built only from merchants that appear in the attached Scotiabank and NCB statements. Ownership is stated only where it is a known, cited fact; otherwise the merchant is marked independent or left for the category rules. Two independent signals are recorded per merchant: categoryConfidence (can a spending category be assigned) and ownershipVerified (is the corporate parent confirmed). Only a genuinely unassignable category ever sets reviewRequired; an unverified owner never does.

fieldNotes.categoryConfidence: how confident we are that the SPENDING CATEGORY is right, judged from the descriptor and business-type naming alone, independent of who owns the business. high|medium|low.
fieldNotes.confidence: deprecated alias of categoryConfidence, kept for backward compatibility with older importers.
fieldNotes.ownershipVerified: true only when the parent company / corporate structure is confirmed by a citable source. Purely informational - it never on its own causes reviewRequired.
fieldNotes.reviewRequired: the ONLY signal shown to a user. true only when no credible spending category can be assigned (an individual/personal payee, a garbled descriptor, or two-plus materially different categories with no way to choose). An unverified owner never sets this.
fieldNotes.aliases: lowercase regex patterns tested against the first comma-segment of a statement descriptor
fieldNotes.category: must be one of the categories defined in config.json
fieldNotes.sector: finer-grained than category; used for sector roll-ups
fieldNotes.locationOverrides: OPTIONAL array, used only when different physical branches of the SAME brand are materially different business types (e.g. a department-store chain whose one branch is actually a standalone grocery concession). Each entry is { match: [alias patterns tested against the FULL descriptor, unlike the merchant's own top-level aliases which only see the business-name segment], businessType?, category?, sector?, categoryConfidence?, reviewRequired?, notes? }. Only the fields present override the parent merchant's own values; merchantGroup/canonicalName/brand are never overridable here by design, so every branch still collapses into one Top Places / recurring-detection group under the shared brand, only its category can differ. Leave unset for the normal case (a brand's branches are all the same business type).
